component: Asset-backed image-format and BRES image-path census

method.pvr_wrapper: exact first 8 bytes BTEXpvr\0; parse 52-byte legacy PVR header beginning at offset 8; require PVR! at header offset 44 for parsed rows
method.png: 8-byte PNG signature and read IHDR fields when present
method.jpeg: JPEG SOI bytes FF D8 at file start
method.dds: DDS followed by space at file start
method.atc: the native ATC probe reads a 16-bit tag at file offset 4 and accepts 0x8c92 or 0x8c93
method.tga: structural header candidate scan (plausible image type/color map/dimensions/pixel depth/descriptor); TGA has no fixed magic
method.bres_image_paths: For each BRES image-library record (20-byte stride), read the +0x08 field only when its offset is in the BRES fixup table, then read its bounded NUL-terminated string. Normalize only known q:/data/iphone/, q:/data/old/, or data/ roots and compare full relative paths case-insensitively; no basename matching.

pvr_header_summary.mapping_note: Raw type 0x18 maps to engine format 24 or 25; raw type 0x19 maps to 26 or 27. The 0x8000 header bit selects the alternate in each pair. The 4/2 header bpp fields agree with those type families in the observed corpus.

bres_image_path_summary.interpretation_limit: These are image-table +0x08 path-shaped strings and exact cache path matches. Existing native evidence establishes CImage reads SImage +0x10, not the +0x08 field; no runtime path consumer or material-to-image relationship is established here.

interpretation_limit: The normalized full-path joins identify recovered image assets. Independently, the APK static trace in ../../engine-materials/texture-runtime-link/ANALYSIS.md establishes that CResFactory::getTexture reads SImage+0x08, ordinary sampler image indices map to SImage rows, and the returned ITexture is stored at +0x10 for later material construction. This does not prove every matched path succeeds or is active in a rendered frame; exact path normalization and factory-object configuration remain open.
